# Test fixtures

All fixtures in this directory contain synthetic identifiers, timestamps, readings, costs, URLs, and free text.

- `usage.xml` is a minimal hand-written Atom/ESPI relationship fixture.
- `opower-live-shape-v1.xml` preserves the resource ordering, namespace arrangement, and non-sensitive ReadingType metadata of an observed Opower export. Its customer fields and measurements were replaced before it entered the repository.

These fixtures demonstrate parser behavior; they are not Green Button Alliance certification vectors and do not assert complete ESPI conformance.
